title: Julian Jaynes' bicameral mind theory: a shift in consciousness after 1000 BC

tellings.quote: there's a guy named Julian James. I don't know if you've heard of him. He was a um Yale professor. He wrote a book called um uh on the origins of consciousness and the bicamal mind.

plain: Julian Jaynes, a Yale professor, argued that human consciousness changed in the ancient world, sometime after 1000 BC, when an older "bicameral," or two-chambered, way of thinking broke down. Michels brings him up himself on an episode about the pyramids and names, a little loosely, Jaynes's book The Origin of Consciousness in the Breakdown of the Bicameral Mind. If true, ancient people may have experienced their own minds very differently from the way we do.
